mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the tightening labor market predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as corporations benefit from higher demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of this mechanism with SPX returns is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing down to below 1.5% QoQ indicates decreased demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth slows below 1.5% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50bps in a single meeting indicates a hawkish monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors reassess risk.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 5d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) following such rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp in two consecutive months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to below 100K, the weakening labor market predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, due to decreased consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.5pp over 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 100K
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market impacts on consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.1) when both labor market conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as retailers and related industries benefit.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of this mechanism with SPX returns is below 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
